entry.name: jit.gl.camera
entry.description: Sets the properties needed to define a view in OpenGL. These include field of view, clipping planes, and perspective or orthographic projection modes. In addition a position and orientation can be defined for a virtual camera in 3D space, and the proper view will be generated from these transforms.
